PRESENCE ACADEMY ✦
6th Grade - 8th Grade
A transformative middle school experience
In Presence Academy , 6th-8th grade students are equipped with the academic skills, spiritual foundation, and leadership qualities they need to thrive.

Our middle school program goes beyond textbooks, encouraging students to think critically , problem-solve creatively , and lead confidently , all while being rooted in biblical truth . Middle school is a time of growth, discovery, and preparation for future success. In Presence Academy, we prioritize the development of reasoning and analytical skills , helping students make connections and engage deeply with the world around them. Our curriculum challenges students to think for themselves , solve problems , and lead with integrity .
Rooted in Truth. Prepared for Every Sphere of Society.
What Sets Presence Academy Apart ?

Choosing the right middle school for your child is one of the most important decisions you'll make. In Presence Academy , we provide an environment where academic excellence , spiritual formation , and personal growth go hand in hand. Here’s what makes us unique:

items: Christ-Centered Learning: Every subject is taught through the lens of biblical truth, encouraging students to develop a Christian worldview while excelling academically.

Academic Excellence: Our challenging curriculum fosters critical thinking, problem-solving, and analytical reasoning, equipping students with the skills they need to succeed in high school and beyond.
Character Formation: We prioritize leadership development, compassion, and integrity, helping students grow into confident, Christ-like leaders who impact their communities.

Safe & Secure Campus: We have invested in a state-of-the-art security system and we are located in the historic Butler High School, originally built as a military shelter during the Cold War, ensuring unparalleled safety.

Small Class Sizes: With personalized attention and a standards-based learning approach, we meet the unique needs of every learner, ensuring that each student receives the support and challenge they need to thrive.

ROYAL HOUR
Character & Leadership Development

At Kingdom Heights, we don’t just educate—we equip future leaders . Our students are encouraged to grow spiritually, academically, and socially. We foster biblical character traits like integrity, humility, resilience, and compassion.

Royal Hour: Each day, students participate in Royal Hour , a dedicated time for tutoring, enrichment, or extracurricular clubs . This encourages students to take ownership of their education , explore interests, and seek help when needed.
Empower your child to thrive.
Standards-Based Grading & Limited Homework

At Kingdom Heights, we believe education should be progress-driven, not pressure-driven . Our standards-based grading approach ensures students advance only when they’ve mastered each concept . If a student needs more time, they receive personalized support without falling behind. Likewise, students ready to move ahead can progress without unnecessary repetition.
We also believe in protecting family time . That’s why homework is limited , ensuring evenings are spent connecting, creating, and resting , not stressing over assignments.
Learn how we balance academic success and family life.
